author: marcfeuermann
body: It is tricky to decide up to where one can propagate terms related to complexes. Names, number of subunits and specific subunits can change from one organism to another. I replaced the CC by "endoplasmic retculum" which seems to make consensus in eukaryotes and I highly restricted the annotation to the complex.
